Vehicles and structures

Nazir

الناظر

Also called: waqf administrator; nazir board

Definition

The nazir is the person or body that administers a waqf, managing its assets, collecting its income and distributing it as the waqf deed requires.

What it means

The waqf deed usually names the nazir and says how a successor is chosen. A nazir can be an individual, a board or an institution. The nazir holds the waqf’s assets in trust: it must preserve them, follow the founder’s conditions and act in the beneficiaries’ interest.

For a larger waqf, a nazir board with clear decision rights, accounts and regular reports makes the waqf easier to run and to check.

How HAYKALAH uses it

Nazir governance is part of HAYKALAH’s family and charitable waqf design and of its waqf-manager model, together with establishing the waqf and distributing its income. HAYKALAH’s 2021 waqf proposal for a Saudi family included seating the first nazir board.
